notes.title: 11 June 2021 - Patch 1.1b
notes.notes:
UPDATES(1.1b)
---------------------
- Added color coding to item pickups. Also slowed the fade speed.
- Brightened up many of the levels that where too dark.
- Added a conjuring inventory(item) panel to the conjuring table so players can see what items are needed for each category.
- Added code that scaled text tooltips based on monitor resolution.
- Added backgrounds to dialog to make the text stand out more.
- Started modifying code for controller support.
- Started adding code for a full inventory support.
- Added an overview map toggle where players can get a much larger view of the map. This makes it easier for them to see where to go.
- Fixed a bug where an enemy pack would not activate.
- Added a Town Scroll that when collected, the player can teleport to a town. The player can then recover and explore the town area, purchase items etc. Use to the teleport close by to return to the same area.
